source.section: PR Newswire earnings release · Q2 2026 highlights (Core FFO, not Nareit FFO)
source.quote: Achieved $0.65 of Core FFO per diluted share for the second quarter of 2026, an increase of 3.2% compared to the second quarter of 2025

source.section: PR Newswire earnings release · Q2 2026 highlights (Same Store Cash NOI, cash basis)
source.quote: Produced Same Store Cash NOI of $158.8 million for the second quarter of 2026, an increase of 3.4% compared to the second quarter of 2025

source.section: 10-Q Item 2 MD&A · Results of Operations (Same Store portfolio occupancy)
source.quote: Same store occupancy decreased approximately 1.8% to 96.0% as of June 30, 2026 compared to 97.8% as of June 30, 2025
